description: Öffentlicher Verkehr is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. Das Geoprodukt beinhaltet die Linien, Haltestellen und Einzugsgebiete des öffentlichen Verkehrs im Kanton Bern für das aktuelle Fahrplanjahr. Die Angaben beziehen sich dabei getrennt auf die sechs verschiedenen Kategorien von Verkehrsmitteln (Bahn, Bus, Tram, Nachtlinien, Seilbahn, Schiff). Coverage: Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. The portal files it under the publisher Amt für Geoinformation des Kantons Bern. It offers 10 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, OCTET, PARQUET. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
